# Opal

Opal is a dual light and dark theme on a muted macaron palette, described as WCAG-checked and styled identically for reading view and Live Preview. Around 82 Style Settings cover colors, fonts, headings and layout, and the theme includes Canvas and Properties support, plugin adaptations, print-ready CSS and accessibility fallbacks. The contrast claim is the description's own.

![Opal screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cyriusweng/opal-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Opal"
    author: "Cyrius Weng"

    github_url:     "https://github.com/cyriusweng/opal-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cyriusweng/opal-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a WCAG-checked dual light/dark theme with a muted macaron palette and equal styling for reading view and Live Preview. Adjust ~82 Style Settings for colors, fonts, headings and layout; get Canvas/Properties support, plugin adaptations, print-ready CSS and accessibility fallbacks."
}
```
